item.title: Show HN: Likeface, make typefaces you like
item.summary: (likeface.net redirects there too) tldr: Make a downloadable & installable font from a text description, a photo with 5+ letters of a font you want, or by uploading a TTF/OTF file. $6 max per base font generation, cheaper if you buy GET tokens in bulk. For 2 GET total, get 500+ glyphs and bold/italic versions. {content continues in initial comment} Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49211748 Points: 2 # Comments: 2
